entities.summary: Bidar is a city and the headquarters of the Bidar district in Karnataka state of India. Bidar is a prominent place on the archaeological map of India. It is well known for architectural, historical religious and rich heritage sites. Picturesquely perched on the Deccan Plateau, the Bidar fort is more than 500 years old and still standing strong. According to the book "Bidar Heritage" published by the state Department of Archaeology, Museums and Heritage, of the 61 monuments listed by the department, about 30 are tombs located in and around Bidar city., hence its nickname, "City of Whispering Monuments".

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Bidar's historical significance lies in its well-preserved architectural and religious heritage sites, with over 30 tombs located within the city, making it a prominent regional cultural center. Its rich history dates back to the 14th century, with the Bidar fort standing as a testament to its enduring legacy.
